{
  "categories": [

      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/interfaces/mining.h`, `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`, `test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py`, and addresses asynchronous IPC cleanup during shutdown.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Adds memory load tracking across the IPC boundary for Stratum v2 clients and fixes asynchronous template cleanup during node shutdown. As ryanofsky noted, this helps to 'harden mining interface and track resource usage' while supporting active downstream integration in sv2-tp."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mining label, implements memory tracking in `BlockTemplateManager`, and updates the mining interface.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Enables external mining clients to monitor and mitigate memory exhaustion caused by templates pinning evicted mempool transactions. According to the PR description, external clients can hold templates indefinitely, and this change provides the visibility required by Stratum v2 template providers (sv2-tp#63) to prune stale templates."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch RPC endpoints, HTTP server code, REST, or ZMQ.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR modifies the IPC Mining interface and Cap'n Proto definitions rather than node RPC interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Unit and functional test modifications are specific to mining and IPC mining tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test changes in `src/test/miner_tests.cpp` and `test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py` validate template memory tracking rather than test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/init.cpp` and `src/node/context.h` solely for `BlockTemplateManager` lifetime management.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Switching `BlockTemplateManager` to `std::shared_ptr` in node context serves mining IPC shutdown handling rather than shared utility libraries."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter consensus rules, block connection, or chainstate validation logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
